subject.title: fix(ci): keep markdown-only PR jobs off Blacksmith

question: Should maintainers adopt this early hosted `ci_scope` approach as the fix for Markdown-only PR Blacksmith queueing after a rebase, or keep the linked issue open for a different CI-routing strategy?
rationale: The linked issue is still real on current main, but the PR now conflicts with active CI runner work and needs an owner decision on the preferred automation shape before merge.

options.title: Adopt after rebase
options.body: Rebase this branch onto current main, preserve the hosted docs-only scope gate, and require fresh exact-head workflow proof before merge.

options.title: Choose another routing shape
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and ask for a narrower or different CI-routing PR if maintainers prefer trigger-level paths or another owner-approved design.

options.title: Close this branch
options.body: Close this PR if the branch is no longer worth resolving against current CI churn, while preserving the issue as the canonical remaining work.

recommendation.title: Adopt after rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase this branch onto current main, preserve the hosted docs-only scope gate, and require fresh exact-head workflow proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main CI runner-capacity work makes this the strongest available owner signal for the rebase and routing-policy decision.
